title: dryopteris affinis subsp. pseudocomplexa
intro: Dryopteris affinis subsp. pseudocomplexa, commonly known as the golden buckler fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris affinis subsp. pseudocomplexa include soothing and protecting the skin, as well as acting as an anti-irritant and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
